name: use-controllable-state
title: useControllableState
description: The value, defaultValue and onChange pattern for custom components that can be controlled or uncontrolled.
a11y: No DOM output. Lets a custom widget accept value/defaultValue/onValueChange like the Monoline components do.
onChange fires only when the new value differs from the current one.
